transcript: I can be overly detail oriented which sometimes slows me down so to address this I've started using project management tools like monday.com to prioritize and delegate tasks more effectively here's another example I Am Naturally not a numbers person so I do tend to lean on team members with stronger analytical skills but I've realized the importance of being able to analyze data on your own so I've actually taken on some coursework that's really helped me with data analysis as well as worked on some projects internally worked with team members to teach me some of the data analyst tools that they've been using
